visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a street-side electronics store. A black motorcycle with red accents is parked in the foreground, taking up most of the lower frame. In the background, a large glass window displays a promotional poster for the 'Galaxy Tab S10 Series' with Galaxy AI branding. The lighting is natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the pavement. (2) The scene transitions to a handheld follow shot of a male character in a white t-shirt and dark blue trousers walking through a glass sliding door into the store. The interior is brightly lit with warm studio lighting. The background features a service counter and various blue seating areas. (3) A close-up shot focuses on promotional posters for the Galaxy Z Flip7 inside the store. The male character is seen from the back, interacting with a staff member behind a counter. Various tech devices and accessories are visible on shelves and display tables in the background. (4) The camera shifts to a top-down view on a wooden table. A pair of hands with a gold ring on the thumb begins unboxing a black 'Galaxy Z Flip7' box. The hands peel off the adhesive seals and lift the lid to reveal a navy blue foldable phone. (5) A series of close-up shots show the removal of protective plastic films from the phone's exterior and screen. The phone is then powered on, displaying the 'SAMSUNG' logo followed by a 'Welcome' screen in Traditional Chinese. The user demonstrates the folding mechanism, showing the hinge and the cover screen. (6) The final phase shows the phone being held in the hand, displaying the time and date on the cover screen. The lighting highlights the glossy finish of the device and the dual-camera setup on the back.

The vocal maintains a steady pitch contour without significant tension. (3) A distinct mechanical 'click' and plastic 'rustle' SFX trigger as the box is opened. Simultaneously, an upbeat electronic pop BGM enters with a rhythmic synth beat and female vocals in English. The music is mixed lower than the narration. (4) Sharp, high-frequency transients are heard as the protective films are peeled off the device. These 'crinkle' sounds are crisp and well-recorded. The narrator provides technical details about trade-in offers over the music. (5) The narrator's voice remains the dominant signal until the end. The music swells slightly in volume during the transitions between sentences, maintaining a cheerful and energetic vibe. A final thud sound is heard as the phone is placed on the table.

It serves as both a lifestyle vlog and a soft promotion, providing viewers with useful shopping information such as trade-in discounts and specific store locations that might still have promotional serial numbers available.
